topic: Owl: can turn its head about 270 degrees, and its soft feathers let it fly almost silently.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: The Owl’s Silent Surprise

shots.narration: Did you know an owl can look behind itself?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated woodland clearing, an owl perched above Kiko and Pip, no text.
shots.action: The owl turns its head toward Kiko behind its perch.
shots.mood: Sunny golden light, sparkling leaves, wide-eyed wonder.

shots.narration: Kiko wants a closer look, but leafy branches hide it.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, leafy woodland canopy above a fern-covered path, owl partly concealed by foliage, no text.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward the leafy canopy.
shots.mood: Bright natural greens, curious expression, playful mystery.

shots.narration: [whispers] There it is! Watch that amazing head turn.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cute true-to-life owl on a broad branch, Pip hovering nearby, no text.
shots.action: The owl slowly turns its head while its body stays still.
shots.mood: Warm sunshine, clear feather detail, quiet anticipation.

shots.narration: An owl can turn its head about 270 degrees.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the same perched owl against softly blurred woodland, no text.
shots.action: The owl demonstrates a broad head turn without making a complete circle.
shots.mood: Bright natural colours, gentle movement, fascinating close-up.

shots.narration: But its other superpower is much harder to hear.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko beneath the owl's branch in a sunny forest clearing, no text.
shots.action: Kiko cups a hand behind his ear.
shots.mood: Expectant smile, dappled sunlight, quiet suspense.

shots.narration: [surprised] Those soft feathers help it fly almost silently!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same owl above a fern-lined woodland opening, soft wing feathers clearly visible, no text.
shots.action: The owl glides across the clearing with wings spread.
shots.mood: Airy golden light, graceful motion, gentle amazement.

shots.narration: Kiko barely notices the owl passing behind him.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko listening beneath tall trees, owl visible behind his shoulder, no text.
shots.action: The owl glides behind Kiko toward a low branch.
shots.mood: Playful surprise, soft green background, peaceful woodland.

shots.narration: There it is again: a quiet woodland wonder!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, owl resting on a low branch near Kiko and Pip, sunlit ferns below, no text.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the perched owl.
shots.mood: Delighted discovery, warm smiles, bright natural colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Which ocean animal comes next? Can you guess?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, woodland edge overlooking a sparkling blue ocean, no other animals and no text.
shots.mood: Sunny horizon, shimmering water, inviting adventure.

episode.endHook: Which ocean animal will Kiko and Pip discover next?
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover how an owl turns its head about 270 degrees and flies almost silently with soft feathers. Can you guess which ocean animal they will meet next?
